e3ba9910d6.q: What is the biggest barrier preventing people from using Sundays support services?
e3ba9910d6.a: The first barrier is simply allowing yourself to feel like you deserve help. Many people work hard but feel they haven't done enough or haven't accomplished enough on their own before they can justify accepting support. People often set arbitrary definitions of what milestones they need to hit before deserving help, but you don't actually know what it will take to reach those points before you get there. Additionally, people tie their sense of self to their activity and responsiveness, creating a nervous system attachment to being the fastest to respond and the first to see everything.

268724376e.a: When you hand off tasks to someone else, your body may resist even though intellectually you want the relief.
